judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a clean, accurate implementation that satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue. Like the reference, it chooses to accumulate per-round usage via a pure `accumulateUsage` helper, renames the `afterModelResponse` parameter to make the sum explicit (`turnUsage` vs `totalUsage` in the reference), and updates the specs (`hal-engine-config-hooks`, `hal-engine-architecture`, `hal-engine-tool-input-validation`), `CLAUDE.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` accordingly. The candidate places `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` with unit tests and adds an acceptance test file in addition to testing inside `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, which is a minor and completely idiomatic structural difference. All edge cases (multi-round summation, missing per-round usage, and all-undefined usage) are properly handled and tested without altering existing single-round tests.
